head_commit.message:
fix(keyring): implement token chunking for Windows keyring length limit

Fixes #10353

Windows Credential Manager has a 2560-byte limit for UTF-16 encoded passwords.
OAuth tokens often exceed this limit, causing authentication failures.

This change implements transparent chunking for large values:
- Values exceeding 1024 characters are split into chunks
- Main key stores header with chunk count and first chunk
- Additional chunks stored in account:1, account:2, etc.
- Load/delete operations automatically handle chunked values

Tested on Windows 11 with values up to 5000 characters.
